function.description: This tool belongs to the vehicle control system, which allows users to control various aspects of the car such as engine, doors, climate control, lights, and more. pedalPosition.description: Position of the brake pedal, between 0 (not pressed) and 1 (fully pressed). This is a float type value.

brakePedalStatus.description: The status of the brake pedal. [Enum]: ["pressed", "released"]

brakePedalForce.description: The force applied to the brake pedal in Newtons.
